text:
maria: FYI — noticed nightly SAST/DAST run stopped attaching scan evidence to PRs after we switched artifact-bucket to customer-managed CMK.
jon: yup saw pipeline flakiness this morning. upload step failed with `AccessDenied` from the scanner role.
alyssa: log snippet?
jon: here's the relevant bit from the job output:
```
ERROR: Upload failed: PutObject failed: AccessDenied
caused by: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456:assumed-role/scanner-role is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```
maria: confirmed — S3 shows the PUT but CloudTrail doesn't show a corresponding `GenerateDataKey`/`Encrypt` call. looks like the request was blocked before KMS op.
patrick: I think this is a key policy vs role assumption problem. When we moved to CMK we tightened key policy to only allow the infra service account and the owner's role; scanner-role wasn't included.
jon: that would match. scanner assumes role via CI, then tries to `PutObject` with `x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id`. KMS enforces key policy first.
alyssa: quick mitigation: we can change the bucket to SSE-S3 to restore uploads immediately, but that removes CMK auditability. tradeoff.
maria: prefer not to revert unless necessary. can we update key policy to permit `kms:Encrypt` and `kms:GenerateDataKey` for the scanner-role principal and require `kms:Encrypt` only (no `Decrypt`)?
patrick: yes, add a key policy statement scoped to the scanner role ARN with actions: `kms:Encrypt`, `kms:GenerateDataKey`, `kms:DescribeKey`.
jon: example binding (to be templatized in terraform):
```
{
  "Sid": "AllowScannerRoleToEncrypt",
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::123456:role/scanner-role"},
  "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource": "*"
}
```
maria: also we discovered an observability gap: CloudTrail did not flag the blocked KMS call as an offending event in our alerting query (it was filtered out by a recent ingest rule). we need to fix detection.
alyssa: action items:
- jon: open terraform PR to patch key policy + unit test (owner: jon)
- alyssa: update artifact-bucket terraform module to add a feature-flag for `enable_cmk_support` and a migration note (owner: alyssa)
- maria: run canary SAST/DAST scan against a test repo after policy is rolled (owner: maria)
- patrick: add a Kibana alert for `sast_upload_failures > 5` in 10m and a CloudTrail rule to surface `kms:Encrypt` denied events (owner: patrick)
jon: filing PR now. will include a short plan for backout and an acceptance test where CI uploads an ephemeral artifact.
devsec-bot: Incident created: INC-5123 — \"scan evidence upload blocked by CMK policy\" — assigned to eng-security. See https://incidents.internal/INC-5123
sre-bot: deploy check: terraform plan shows only key policy changes, no bucket recreation. ETA to apply if PR passes: ~30m after merge.
maria: note for postmortem: we should add an onboarding checklist for CMK rollouts that enumerates all service principals that interact with the bucket (scanner-role, archivist lambda, evidence-exporter). missed that during rollout.
alyssa: also adding a small test harness to the scanner repo that exercises SSE-KMS uploads in CI.
patrick: once PR merged i'll add the alert and smoke test to the runbook. add `:eyes:` react when you want me to apply.
jon: PR -> https://git.internal/redwood/infra/compare/patch-cmk-scanner-policy (WIP). added terraform unit tests.
maria: after PR merged i'll trigger nightly job manually to validate. if upload still fails revert to SSE-S3 as emergency fallback.
alyssa: good. will draft a short playbook paragraph for the runbook: detect -> patch key policy -> smoke upload -> monitor 1h -> close incident. include rollback steps.
patrick: FYI i found one more subtlety: if scanner uses temporary credentials (sts) the KMS principal must reference the assumed role ARN or allow the sts principal pattern. i'll include that caveat in the PR description.
maria: thanks team. keeping INC-5123 open until we verify evidence attachments present on next successful run.
jon: will update the incident ticket with the terraform PR link and test results.
maria: closing note: let's also add an audit check in the pre-merge SAST runner that validates evidence upload succeeded and fails the job fast with a clear error (right now it retries silently and hides the reason). small change but big operability win.
alyssa: :thumbsup:
patrick: :shipit:
